an10.16:1.1: dasayime bhikkhave puggalā āhuneyyā pāhuneyyā dakkhiṇeyyā añjalikaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa
an10.16:1.3: tathāgato arahaṃ sammāsambuddho paccekasambuddho ubhatobhāgavimutto paññāvimutto kāyasakkhi diṭṭhippatto saddhāvimutto dhammānusārī saddhānusārī gotrabhū
an10.16:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave dasa puggalā āhuneyyā …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
